result.topic_en: Brief notes on biquadratic (quartic) residue symbols in the Gaussian integers for the modulus 7 and the prime 5+2i, including a reciprocity-type congruence and a small table of symbol values.

methods.what: Congruence relating the quartic residue symbol of 5+2i modulo 7 to a power of the symbol of -7 modulo 5+2i (reciprocity-type relation)
Product of the quartic residue symbols of conjugate Gaussian integers 5-2i and 5+2i modulo 7 equals 1
Table of corresponding values of the symbols for 5+2i and its conjugate 5-2i modulo 7 (conjugate values are inverses)

items.english: The product of the symbol of (5-2i) modulo 7 and the symbol of (5+2i) modulo 7 equals 1.
The symbol of (5+2i) modulo 7 is congruent mod 7 to the cube of the symbol of -7 modulo (5+2i).
